comments.value: I don't entirely understand. Can you describe in what way your avatar is moving? Is it acting as if you're pushing a directional input?

@{59b80cbbd1662e660835c7c5|full_name}: 
Try powering off one controllers.
If you are VIVE, it should be as follows.

fingerpoint : Forward
Victory : "turn Left" or "turn right"
Rocknroll : Backward
Push : Jump

The problem is that this happens when the tracking of one controller is lost.
This is not a necessary function, so please improve it so that it can be turned on and off on the setting screen.

I think when you're still moving and then your controller is not working / turned off / lost tracking at same time while pressed function is active.
This will cause avatar will still act on last pressed button. If you move sideways while controller went off, it will stay walk sideways.

It's better avatar stop and going in neutral when controller is lost.

@{5bcbaf75fab2337b72ced6b0|full_name}: 
The operation continues to receive new input.
Not a disconnected controller but another.
Please try hide one controller with cloth.
If you are VIVE, it should be as follows.

details:
Regarding the fact that the avatar moves by itself when the gesture is being displayed.

The update causes the avatar to move or jump on its own if the tracking of one controller is lost while the gesture is being displayed or avatar is moving.

I think this is the fatal error as an SNS application.

It is a great update that makes you can move and jump the avatar with a controller itself.
However, this is not a necessary function, so please improve it so that it can be turned on and off on the setting screen.

I hope your immediate response.


ジェスチャー表示時にアバターが勝手に移動する件について。

アップデートによりジャスチャー表示中や移動中に片方のコントローラーのトラッキングが失われると、
アバターが勝手に移動したり、ジャンプするようになりました。

これはSNSアプリケーションとして致命的なものだと考えています。

コントローラー一つで移動やジャンプが可能になったのは素晴らしいアップデートだと思います。
しかしこれは通常時に必要なものではないため、設定画面でONOFFができるように改善をお願いいたします。

早急な対応を望みます。
title: Regarding the fact that the avatar moves by itself when the gesture is being displayed.
